current_definition: Trees per acre unadjusted: number of trees per acre represented by the sampled tree based on sample design; mapped fixed-radius values SUBP=6.018046, MICR=74.965282, MACR=0.999188.
estimator_role: Tree-level per-acre contribution before nonresponse/stratum expansion.
EVALID_dependence: Indirect: value is design-specific; population use must join a coherent evaluation.
required_join_key: TREE.PLT_CN -> PLOT/COND; through plot to population strata
uncertainty_caveat: For old variable-radius designs value may depend on tree diameter. Must not be treated as a population total by itself.

current_definition: Tree status code; STATUSCD=1 identifies live trees in official population-estimation examples.
estimator_role: Filters Q1 target to live trees.
EVALID_dependence: No direct EVALID field dependence, but only records belonging to chosen evaluation may enter estimate.
uncertainty_caveat: D09 does not select final Q1 biological exclusions beyond the frozen live-tree object.

current_definition: Diameter used by official estimator logic to select microplot/subplot/macroplot adjustment factor.
estimator_role: Determines sample element/adjustment factor in Example 3-3.
uncertainty_caveat: For frozen large-tree object (>=5 in d.b.h./d.r.c.), microplot is normally excluded; macroplot may still apply above breakpoint.

current_definition: Diameter breakpoint above which trees are sampled on macroplot when macroplot design applies.
estimator_role: Selects ADJ_FACTOR_MACR rather than SUBP for sufficiently large trees.
EVALID_dependence: Plot/design dependent; can vary by inventory/design.
uncertainty_caveat: Null/absent breakpoint is treated as no macroplot breakpoint in official example logic.

current_definition: Condition status; official forest-land examples use COND_STATUS_CD=1.
estimator_role: Defines forest-land domain when forest land is target denominator/domain.
uncertainty_caveat: Q1 target total over all land vs forest-land restriction is a mainline target-definition issue; current frozen object refers qualifying trees represented by survey data.

current_definition: Area represented by the sampled unit; usually a plot. Official guide: stratum area divided by number of sampled plots in that stratum.
unit: acres per sampled unit (when area is acres)
estimator_role: Converts adjusted per-acre plot/tree contribution to population total contribution.
uncertainty_caveat: Not a universal tree weight independent of evaluation. Reusing it after changing the sample can be invalid.

current_definition: Adjustment factor for subplot; compensates partially nonsampled plot area.
estimator_role: Multiplies TPA_UNADJ for subplot-measured trees.
EVALID_dependence: YES; stored on evaluation-specific stratum record.
uncertainty_caveat: Current national field name verified as ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP.

current_definition: Adjustment factor for microplot; compensates partially nonsampled plot area.
estimator_role: Multiplies TPA_UNADJ for microplot trees/seedlings.
EVALID_dependence: YES; stored on evaluation-specific stratum record.
uncertainty_caveat: Not normally used for frozen >=5-inch large-tree object.

current_definition: Adjustment factor for macroplot; compensates partially nonsampled plot area.
estimator_role: Multiplies TPA_UNADJ for macroplot-measured large trees.
EVALID_dependence: YES; stored on evaluation-specific stratum record.
uncertainty_caveat: Must be respected where macroplot breakpoint/design applies.

current_definition: Phase-1 point/pixel count for stratum used to derive stratum weight in FIADB implementation.
estimator_role: Supports W_h / phase-1 stratum area proportion.
uncertainty_caveat: Current poststratification concept is wall-to-wall pixel proportion; FIADB stores phase-1 counts for implementation.

current_definition: Phase-2 sampled plot count associated with stratum.
estimator_role: Supports sample-size/expansion and variance bookkeeping.
uncertainty_caveat: For custom domain variance, parent stratum sample counts remain relevant even when many domain observations are zero.

current_definition: Unique stratum record identifier.
estimator_role: Key joining plot assignment to the evaluation-specific stratum.
uncertainty_caveat: Use CN keys, not human-readable STRATUMCD alone, for joins.

current_definition: Foreign key linking population plot-stratum assignment to PLOT.
estimator_role: Connects a measured plot visit to design information.
uncertainty_caveat: A plot can have assignment records for different evaluations; choose coherent EVALID.

current_definition: Foreign key linking a plot assignment to POP_STRATUM.
estimator_role: Assigns plot to poststratum for an evaluation.
uncertainty_caveat: Critical for valid EXPNS/adjustment factor association.

current_definition: Evaluation identifier on plot-stratum assignment.
estimator_role: Guards against mixing plot assignments from different evaluations.
uncertainty_caveat: Calendar-year filtering without EVALID coherence can select records outside one official design object.

current_definition: Unique estimation-unit record identifier.
estimator_role: Parent unit for strata; basic building block for geographic totals.
uncertainty_caveat: Estimation units do not cross State boundaries.

current_definition: Foreign key from estimation unit to POP_EVAL.
estimator_role: Connects estimation unit/strata to a specific evaluation.
uncertainty_caveat: Required to keep design metadata coherent.

current_definition: Area used to calculate expansion factors.
estimator_role: Parent-population area basis for expansion.
uncertainty_caveat: For custom area control at 50 km, existing AREA_USED is parent EU area, not automatically the cell area.

current_definition: Evaluation record and identifier.
estimator_role: Defines statistical sample/target population/stratification package.
uncertainty_caveat: A national 2017–2023 calendar filter is not itself one EVALID.

current_definition: Groups evaluations used together by reporting tool/API.
estimator_role: User-facing selection of inventory/evaluation group.
uncertainty_caveat: Current FIADB-API 'wc' usually uses State FIPS + report year.

current_definition: Public coordinates are perturbed; exact coordinates confidential.
estimator_role: Potentially assigns plot to user-defined spatial domain.
uncertainty_caveat: Most public coordinates moved <=0.5 mile, remainder up to 1 mile; some private plots swapped within county. Exact 50-km boundary membership is therefore uncertain in public FIADB.
